sources.title: Meet Namora, Namor's Super Hero Cousin (2022)
Alpha Flight by Mantlo & Lee Omnibus (2026)
Namor the Sub-Mariner Epic Collection: Titans Three (2024)

events.observation: Fen investigates surface explosions, falls in love with the Oracle's captain Leonard McKenzie, and marries him.

events.scope: World War II / Invaders era, in-universe 1942
events.observation: Fen briefly renews Atlantean ties with Nazi Germany; Namor and his surface allies expel the would-be allies.
Thakorr intends an expedition to investigate surface explosions; his daughter Fen instead undertakes the investigation at Tulem's urging.
After an attack on a royal gathering, Namora joins Namor against Stomp Richards's gang; the two subsequently operate as partners.
Namora and Namor quarrel, then embrace and acknowledge attraction; after learning of Tulem's breeding scheme, they abandon plans to marry.

events.scope: Secret Empire: Brave New World (2017) #2; Secret Empire era
events.observation: Namora leads an undersea resistance against Namor's authoritarian neutrality; he captures and nearly executes her before relenting.
Namorita is introduced as Namora's clone-daughter; Namora had taken her into refuge in Lemuria.
Llyra poisons Namora amid rivalry for Prince Merro; the apparent death is later revealed as suspended animation.
Namor's planned marriage to Dorma is disrupted by Llyra's impersonation, and Dorma dies shortly afterward; Marvel summaries differ on marriage status.
Llyra impersonates Dorma during the wedding plot and kills Dorma.

events.scope: Early Silver Age / pre-1971 Atlantean court era
events.observation: While Namor is presumed missing, Krang and Dorma begin a relationship; it ends on Namor's return.
Krang attempts to overthrow Namor, then conspires with Byrrah and Attuma after Namor defeats him.

events.scope: 1953-55 in-universe; Silver Age restoration of Atlantis
events.observation: Byrrah agitates for war with the surface, then rules rebuilt Atlantis during Namor's amnesia; Namor later reclaims the throne.
Attuma seizes Atlantis from Namor and is driven out; their contest for the throne recurs.
Namor, Attuma and Dorma undertake a dangerous attempt to save Atlantis from the Dark Tide.

events.scope: Defenders and later Atlantean council era
events.observation: Marvel identifies Andromeda as Attuma's daughter; she joins the Defenders and is later appointed to a ruling council by Namor.

events.scope: 1980s Avengers/Alpha Flight crossover; later Leviathan crisis
events.observation: Namor and Marrina are married; when Marrina transforms into the destructive Leviathan, Namor strikes her down.
Attuma abducts Marrina, Namor's wife, prompting Alpha Flight and Avengers to intervene.

claims.fact: Fen falls in love with and marries Leonard.
claims.interpretation: The marriage crosses the undersea/surface political divide.

claims.fact: Leonard and Fen marry and become Namor's parents.
claims.interpretation: Reciprocal marital status is documented; private motivations are not.

claims.fact: Fen is Namor's mother; they take opposing sides concerning a wartime Nazi alliance.
claims.interpretation: Kinship does not establish political agreement; no private argument is documented.

claims.fact: Thakorr is Fen's father and intended to investigate the surface crisis before she went herself.
claims.interpretation: Different actions do not prove a personal rupture.

claims.fact: Namora joins Namor against Stomp Richards's gang and subsequently partners with him.
claims.interpretation: Their later political disagreement does not erase this earlier cooperation.

claims.fact: Namora and Namor acknowledge attraction and consider marriage, then abandon the plan.
claims.interpretation: Tulem's manipulation creates uncertainty about how freely their attraction developed.

claims.fact: Namora leads resistance against Namor's authoritarian course during Secret Empire.
claims.interpretation: Event-scoped political opposition; not permanent hatred.

claims.fact: Namor captures Namora and nearly executes her before relenting.
claims.interpretation: The coercive act coexists with their prior partnership and attraction.

claims.fact: Namorita is Namora's clone-daughter and was raised under her care.
claims.interpretation: Clone-derived kinship is not ordinary biological parentage; do not merge identities.

claims.fact: Llyra poisons Namora during rivalry over Prince Merro.
claims.interpretation: The attack produces suspended animation rather than confirmed permanent death.

claims.fact: Namor and Dorma are long-standing lovers and intend to marry.
claims.interpretation: Legal status of the interrupted wedding is inconsistently summarized by Marvel.

claims.fact: Llyra impersonates Dorma and subsequently kills her.
claims.interpretation: A documented lethal act; specific internal motives need original panels.

claims.fact: Krang and Dorma begin a relationship while Namor is absent; it ends when he returns.
claims.interpretation: Historical relationship; not evidence of ongoing affection or coercion.

claims.fact: Krang attempts to depose Namor and later conspires with other challengers.
claims.interpretation: Political competition is documented; personal hatred is not required.

claims.fact: Byrrah agitates against Namor's restraint and seeks/occupies the Atlantean throne.
claims.interpretation: Cousinship and succession rivalry coexist; precise historical retellings vary.

claims.fact: Attuma repeatedly seizes or attempts to seize Namor's throne.
claims.interpretation: An enduring political rivalry, not evidence every encounter is hostile.

claims.fact: Namor and Attuma join Dorma in an attempt to save Atlantis from the Dark Tide.
claims.interpretation: Specific cooperation despite previous and later rivalry.

claims.fact: Andromeda is Attuma's daughter and later serves with the Defenders and Namor's council.
claims.interpretation: Different affiliations do not by themselves prove a father-daughter feud.

claims.fact: Namor and Marrina marry; he later strikes her down when she transforms into Leviathan.
claims.interpretation: Marriage and later lethal force must be chronologically distinguished; survival status is unsettled.

claims.fact: Attuma abducts Marrina, prompting a rescue by Alpha Flight and Avengers.
claims.interpretation: Abduction is a direct coercive act, not a voluntary alliance.

uncertainties: Namora and Namorita are separate people; Namorita is a clone-daughter, not an alias.
Marvel publisher summaries conflict over whether Namor and Dorma's disrupted 1971 wedding legally constituted marriage.
Marvel's 1950s and 1970s Atlantean histories use retrospective chronology; individual panel verification pending.
Andromeda's membership in the Defenders and service on Namor's council do not independently establish hostility toward her father.
Marrina's apparent death and subsequent survival are retcon-sensitive; do not encode permanent death.
The 2020-21 King in Black: Namor story includes earlier-life material; exact in-universe time of the Dark Tide event needs panel review.
